messages_manifest.reason: CLI phase stopped at its original token budget after six calls. This distinct pre-counted protocol uses identical frozen labels/packets; it is a diagnostic replicate, not an untouched holdout. CLI results are reported separately and never pooled.

explicit_query.primary_gate: passes on this small positive subset; negative paired controls remain untested

curated_summary.primary_gate: fails strict citation and median-input gates; no automatic rollout

attribution_scope.primary_gate: no answer gain; retain existing policy

manual_adjudication.review: Citation-rubric disagreement: the answer cites the complete summary and the original archive excerpt, whose visible final clause establishes simulator-only scope. Both citations are relevant. The exact value and scope are supported by the summary; no invented personal value or scope error was found. Frozen automatic score remains 2/3 grounded and 1 citation flag for this intervention, rather than silently relabelling after outputs.

cli_phase.limits: Only six prefix cases; not pooled into the full diagnostic.

embedding_capture.note: Includes one draft input later replaced by the reviewed whole-key control. Replay probe timings exclude real serving time.

summary.description: One manually written archive summary; seven redundant pin texts compressed without changing keys/facts. One authoring pass, no output-driven edits.
summary.timing_limit: Retrospective estimate of text authoring/review, not stopwatch telemetry.

attribution.description: Added explicit owner/date/scope labels to existing plain-text palette notes. Same facts, one pass.

incidence.scope: Pai only, trailing 7 days, excluding synthetic agents
incidence.pin_limit: Capture occupancy is observable; relevance and which unconsidered task evidence was excluded are not logged. Missing exclusion telemetry does not mean zero harms.
incidence.audit_limit: memory_query_truncated is audit clipping at 1000 Unicode characters, NOT embedding truncation at 1024 UTF-8 bytes. Query byte lengths can be derived only when the audit retained the full query. Lexical reads do not embed. Best effort action-labelled calls only; missing observations are not zero. No answer labels in audit.

recommendations.decision: Use the already shipped explicit query for a known detached retrieval need. Keep automatic extraction deferred.
recommendations.evidence: Paired positive answers 2/4→4/4; median input -8.61%, no new primary flags. Middle/tail needs recovered. Four synthetic positives do not establish broad negative non-regression.

recommendations.decision: Allow small owner-reviewed summaries when the need is concrete; defer automated consolidation, bulk rewrites and allocation changes.
recommendations.evidence: Task answers 1/3→3/3 and recovered long/pin-heavy cases, but strict grounded score 1/3→2/3 with one citation-rubric disagreement; median input +20.26% exceeds the 15% gate. Pin-heavy input fell, long-summary input grew. Manual edits were 8 source edits/~6 estimated minutes. Use CA-9 expected_revision for corrections; recovery history is still deferred.

recommendations.decision: Use explicit author/date/scope when writing ambiguous notes; defer mass attribution rewrites.
recommendations.evidence: 3/3→3/3, no measured answer gain, median input +2.26%; 3 edits/~3 estimated minutes. Correct historical/default answers show newest-wins is unnecessary here.

recommendations.decision: Retain current ranking and context budgets; no new cutoff, pin reservation or larger embedding service.
recommendations.evidence: The tiny fixture identifies delivery/query failure modes, not their platform-wide incidence. Fresh negative/quoted/time-scope controls and independent annotation are needed before future policy selection. Do not tune on this observed set and call it held out.

recommendations.decision: Keep answer-only tests on the counted tool-free protocol; retain a few end-to-end native checks for integration.
recommendations.evidence: The full 25-case Messages diagnostic used 76,414 input tokens versus 176,389 for only six CLI answers. This separates harness overhead from memory behavior, without claiming native answer-quality equivalence.

limits: Initial 15-case corpus/labels were new; frozen core labels/score did not change after any answer calls. Read-only methodology review corrected draft labels before the first CLI answer. Retrieval-only draft diagnostics were inspected.

Messages protocol chosen after six CLI outputs existed to fix observed token overhead; same labels/packets, no policy/prompt tuning. It is an observed diagnostic replicate, not an untouched end-to-end holdout.

One stochastic answer per condition, author-created synthetic facts and a disclosed closed scope vocabulary; no generalization, semantic-judge or speed-improvement claim. Interventions have small selected positive subsets and no paired negative expansion.
Three negative baseline cases all abstained; four positive baseline misses also answered null when evidence was absent/incomplete. The latter are end-to-end missed facts, not observed hallucinations.
One strict citation flag is manually disputed and retained in primary metrics. Summary rollout remains deferred even under the favorable adjudication because its median-input gate failed.

Seven-day capture query truncation is missing for all 15 enabled Pai captures, not observed as zero. OPS-40 audit clipping is at 1000 characters, distinct from the embedding byte bound. Of 41 fully retained hybrid-read queries, one exceeded 1024 UTF-8 bytes; this does not establish answer harm. Pin exclusion relevance remains unknown.

All corpus storage was disposable local PostgreSQL; synthetic vectors were captured from the pinned live model. No production persona memories were added or rewritten for CA-10. The CLI worker was removed; its six run/audit records survive. The temporary proxy forward was closed.
